annotations.text:
THE CORE LOOP — left to right.
Onboarding is under 60 seconds and needs no keyboard. Today opens on a big Start, never on an inventory of failure. The minimum (2 min) is what credits the day; the target is aspirational only.

THE TIMER COUNTS UP — there is no countdown and no overrun, so the screen has no failure state. The teal dot on the ring marks where the minimum was crossed: the day was already secured at 2:00, everything after is bonus. Elapsed derives from wall clock, never accumulated ticks, so iOS backgrounding cannot corrupt it.

NO SHAME SURFACES — blank days are neutral gray, never red, never an X. The momentum curve on Practice Detail dips to 23 and climbs back: recency weighting (10-day half-life) is what makes coming back visibly pay. Repair tokens are always an explicit choice, and declining one is written as a fine outcome.

The token sheet is the spec for globals.css.

Three fonts: Sora for display, Outfit for UI, DM Mono for timers and numerals — mono so digits don't jitter as the clock runs.

Amber appears only for repair. It is the warmest colour in the system and it never means 'wrong'.
